title: 第14章 乾坤诀
slug: 道君全本免费-道君最新章节列表
content_zh:
镜背的百花浮雕栩栩如生，证明正是东郭浩然给他的那面铜镜，刚才无意中拿了出来，没想到一直破解不开的谜团在月色下破开了。之前为了破解铜镜之谜，别说月光，就连太阳底下也试了，水煮火烤更是不用说，愣是没瞅出任何端倪，居然在此意外的情况下撞现了端倪！
他又伸手在水缸中的凉水里拨了拨，嘴中依然念念有词，“月为阴，地势坤，水聚阴而显，九宫八卦，怎么就没想到……”嘀嘀咕咕一阵后，又陷入了走神中，想起了古墓中出事前的情形，正是因为他破解了山中的九宫八卦迷障才找到了古墓入口，而他又是因为触及了古墓中的那面古铜镜才出的事。
难道这铜镜真的和古墓中的古铜镜有关？若真如此的话，那个为古墓设置九宫八卦阵的人，其目的怕就是指向这面铜镜，能破阵的人自然就能解开古铜镜之谜。
念及此，他不禁重重拍了拍额头，直摇头，因手上铜镜是东郭浩然给的，让他漏过了什么，若没有在古墓出事，古铜镜带回去经科学仪器透析检查一旦发现端倪，他怕是早就因破古墓大阵而联想到了破解古铜镜的办法。
事情经不起深思，越想越惊疑不定。
按下心中疑虑，回到了现实中，镜子再次对月背水，九个朦胧光点在微微荡漾的水面再次浮现。
牛有道一手持铜镜，一手开始掐指推算，慢慢绕着水缸转圈，对镜背的图案推算定位。
心中有数后，看了看对月的角度，手中镜面一翻，露了镜背对着月光，手指在百花图上的一朵朵浮雕花朵上点着，嘴中嘀咕：“乾、坎、艮、震、中、巽、离、坤、兑！”
确认了那九朵花，他蹲在了水缸边，铜镜扣在了地上，双掌摊开，并排碰了拇指，两根拇指合一，点在了最大的一朵花朵上，左右各四根手指又各摁在了一朵花上。左右四指为八，加中间合并的拇指为九，中间两根拇指翘开又可为阴阳八卦中的两点鱼眼，十指这般合在一起便是九宫八卦指法，他以此指法同时摁住了九朵花，整齐发力，一起摁了下去。
铜镜内“咔嚓”一声轻响，牛有道眉头一跳，不出所料，要找准九朵花一起发力才能破开铜镜的封禁，有一丝错乱也无法双手松开，那九朵之前纹丝不见缝的花朵已经弹凸了起来，花下露出了缝隙。
牛有道拿了铜镜在手，再对着月光照水，那九颗光点已经消失了，再抬头看天，不禁微微点头嘀咕道：“是了！阴破阳出，看来要等到明天见太阳了！”回头四周看了看，快步进了屋内，一夜无心修炼，静候明天日出……
次日露面，外面换了许以天守着，此人始终不屑跟牛有道多一句话，牛有道问了声好，也懒得跟他废话触霉头，知道问了也白问，用了许以天送来的早餐便回了院子。
瞅着旭日阳光，牛有道回桃花堂拿了藏好的铜镜，又出来找了间窗口对阳的房间推开了窗户，镜背对着太阳一照，立见光洁镜面浮现朦胧金晕，密密麻麻的金色光影字样出现在了镜面上，一旁附着三个开篇的金色字样：乾坤诀！
仅凭这三个字，就让牛有道精神一振，再细看小字，很快确认了，是一套修行功法无疑！
不过仅凭这一面，也没多少字。他又翻过铜镜盯着背面的花纹打量，能破开这铜镜的秘密，剩下的花样已经难不住他，稍作推算，捻住一朵花轻轻旋转了一下，闻听轻微咔嚓声而停，再镜背对向阳光，镜面文字已经换了篇，接上了上文，不禁轻声一笑，不出所料，果然如此。
整个白天，他算是抱着铜镜瞅了个如痴如醉，为了追寻阳光，不断换房间，中午甚至爬到梁上捅开了一片瓦来取光。
当阳光彻底消失在了天空，躲在西边厢房内的牛有道才关了窗，将铜镜背面凸起的花纹复了位，弹指敲击了一下镜子，又是浑如一体的声音，谁能想象到里面竟藏了如此玄机。
这一个白天下来，他已经囫囵吞枣式的将镜中所藏内容给大致浏览了遍，里面那真是图文并茂，的的确确是一套完整的修炼法门，不是他那套残缺的《太乙》能比的。
那么多的内容全部藏在了一面镜子里其实并不嫌多，随着镜中机关九宫八卦阵法的错换，镜中画面可千变万化不断翻页，完全可以藏的下这些内容。

content_en:
The relief of flowers on the back of the mirror is lifelike, which proves that it is the bronze mirror Dongguo Haoran gave him. He took it out accidentally just now, but he did not expect that the mystery that had been unsolved was solved under the moonlight. In order to solve the mystery of the bronze mirror, not to mention moonlight, I even tried it under the sun, not to mention boiling and roasting, but I didn't see any clues, but I discovered the clues in this unexpected situation!
He reached out to stir in the cold water in the water tank again, still murmuring, "The moon is yin, the terrain is kun, the water gathers yin and appears, the Nine Palaces and Bagua, why didn't I think of it..." After muttering for a while, he fell into distraction again, remembering the situation before the accident in the ancient tomb. It was because he broke the mystery of the Nine Palaces and Bagua in the mountain that he found the entrance to the ancient tomb, and he happened because he touched the bronze mirror in the ancient tomb.
Is this bronze mirror really related to the ancient bronze mirror in the ancient tomb? If this is the case, the purpose of the person who set up the Nine Palaces and Bagua array for the ancient tomb is probably to point at this bronze mirror. Anyone who can break the array will naturally be able to solve the mystery of the bronze mirror.
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but slapped his forehead heavily and shook his head, because the bronze mirror in his hand was given by Dongguo Haoran, which made him miss something. If nothing happened in the ancient tomb, and the bronze mirror was taken back for dialysis and examination with scientific instruments, once clues were found, he might have thought of a way to crack the ancient bronze mirror because of the ancient tomb formation.
Things cannot stand deep thought, and the more I think about them, the more I become more surprised and uncertain.
I suppressed my doubts and returned to reality. The mirror once again faced the moon, and nine hazy light spots reappeared on the slightly rippling water.
Niu Youdao held the bronze mirror in one hand and began to calculate with the other hand. He slowly circled around the water tank and calculated the position of the pattern on the back of the mirror.
After he knew the angle in his mind, he looked at the angle to the moon, turned the mirror in his hand, and exposed the mirror with its back facing the moonlight. He tapped his fingers on the relief flowers on the Hundred Flowers Diagram, and murmured: "Qian, Kan, Gen, Zhen, Zhong, Xun, Li, Kun, Dui!"
After confirming the nine flowers, he squatted by the water tank, buckled the bronze mirror on the ground, spread out his palms, touched his thumbs side by side, put his two thumbs together and clicked on the largest flower, and pressed four fingers on each side on another flower. The four fingers on the left and right are eight, and the thumb joined in the middle is nine. The two thumbs in the middle can be opened up and can be the two fish eyes in the Yin and Yang Bagua. The ten fingers put together in this way is the Nine Palaces Bagua fingering method. With this fingering method, he pressed the nine flowers at the same time, exerted force in a uniform manner, and pressed them down together.
There was a soft "click" in the bronze mirror, and Niu Youdao's brows jumped. As expected, he had to find the nine flowers and use force together to break the seal of the bronze mirror. Even if there was a trace of confusion, he could not let go with his hands. The nine previously invisible flowers had popped up, and gaps were exposed under the flowers.
Niu Youdao took the bronze mirror in his hand and looked at the moonlight again. The nine light spots had disappeared. He looked up at the sky again and couldn't help but nodded slightly and muttered: "Yes! The yin broke and the sun came out. It seems that we have to wait until tomorrow to see the sun!" He looked around and quickly entered the house. He practiced unintentionally all night and waited for the sunrise tomorrow...
When he showed up the next day, he was guarded by Xu Yitian. This person never bothered to say another word to Niu Youdao. Niu Youdao said hello and was too lazy to talk nonsense to him. Knowing that asking was in vain, he ate the breakfast sent by Xu Yitian and returned to the yard.
Looking at the rising sun, Niu Youdao went back to the Peach Blossom Hall to get the hidden bronze mirror, then went out to find a room with a window facing the sun and opened the window. When the back of the mirror faced the sun, he immediately saw a hazy golden halo appear on the smooth mirror surface. Dense golden light and shadow characters appeared on the mirror surface, and three golden characters at the beginning were attached to the side: Qiankun Jue!
Just these three words made Niu Youdao perk up. Looking at the small words carefully, he quickly confirmed that it was a set of cultivation techniques!
But this side alone doesn’t have many words. He turned over the bronze mirror again and stared at the patterns on the back. If he could reveal the secret of the bronze mirror, the remaining patterns were already there.Unable to resist, he made some calculations, picked up a flower and rotated it gently, heard a slight clicking sound and then stopped. Then he turned the mirror back to the sun. The text on the mirror had been changed to the previous one. He couldn't help but chuckle. As expected, it was indeed the case.
Throughout the day, he held the bronze mirror and stared at it in a mesmerizing way. In order to pursue the sunshine, he kept changing rooms. At noon, he even climbed up to the beam and poked out a tile to get the light.
When the sunlight completely disappeared from the sky, Niu Youdao, who was hiding in the west wing, closed the window, reset the raised patterns on the back of the bronze mirror, tapped his fingers on the mirror, and heard another sound that was like one. Who could have imagined that there was such a mystery hidden inside.
At the end of the day, he had already browsed through the content in the mirror. It was full of pictures and texts. It was indeed a complete set of cultivation methods, which was not comparable to his incomplete "Tai Yi".
It is not too much to hide so much content in a mirror. With the changing of the Nine Palaces and Bagua array of the mechanism in the mirror, the picture in the mirror can be ever-changing and the pages are constantly turned, so these contents can be hidden completely.
